name: admin-reads-everything
find: case 'read': return owner || share !== null || has(user, 'viewer', 'editor');
replace: case 'read': return owner || share !== null || has(user, 'viewer', 'editor', 'admin');

name: other-org-says-forbidden
find: if (user && user.orgId !== doc.orgId) { deny(store, action, actorId, id); return { error: fail('not_found') }; }
replace: if (user && user.orgId !== doc.orgId) { deny(store, action, actorId, id); return { error: fail('forbidden') }; }

name: denial-not-recorded
find: if (!can(store, actorId, action, doc)) { deny(store, action, actorId, id); return { error: fail('forbidden') }; }
replace: if (!can(store, actorId, action, doc)) return { error: fail('forbidden') };
